description: This Java interface defines a builder for handling responses and events related to deleting feature definitions in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building responses and events for delete feature definition commands.

classes.name: ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command responses, including success and error responses.

classes.name: EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating events triggered by delete feature definition commands.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Creates a response indicating successful deletion of a feature definition.

methods.name: featureDefinitionNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the feature definition was not accessible.

methods.name: featureDefinitionNotModifiableError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the feature definition was not modifiable.
